licence.scope: DLR website terms of use (images and video, copyright and terms of use), level 2 (owner's website terms): DLR built the MOS (Modular Optoelectronic Scanner on IRS-P3); the statement is about DLR web content, not the MOS response curves. The SVO-cited DLR paper (https://www.dlr.de/os/Portaldata/48/Resources/dokumente/Paper_Noordwijk10_04.pdf) now returns 404 and carries no checked terms. The NASA OB.DAAC RSR-tables page SVO also lists (https://oceancolor.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/rsr/rsr_tables/) shows no MOS entry and no terms. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
